title: My smoke detector is counting down, not beeping
script_lines: Behind the plastic: a tiny control room.

subtitle_timings.text: Behind the plastic: a tiny control room.

scene_breakdown.label: Hook
scene_breakdown.summary: Smoke detector chirps once at 3AM, single red LED.

scene_breakdown.label: Wrongness
scene_breakdown.summary: Macro push into the detector vents; a faint countdown glow flickers behind the grille instead of a normal alarm beep.

scene_breakdown.label: Reveal
scene_breakdown.summary: Inside: a tiny windowed control room with a glowing number display ticking down, cables, a single chair facing the viewer.

scene_breakdown.label: Twist
scene_breakdown.summary: an original tiny operator character inside the miniature control room, seen as a small cinematic silhouette, no recognizable face, no celebrity, no real person, no brand, no copyrighted character, warm dim control lights, mysterious but cozy magical realism, raises a hand, mouths a warning without sound

scene_breakdown.label: Cliffhanger
scene_breakdown.summary: The countdown hits 1, every light inside cuts to black.
